## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Closes #...`
when this PR resolves it, or `Related to #...` for partial work.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include a reproduction or before/after
example when it helps review.

## Impact

Describe any changes to scientific outputs, saved run compatibility, dependencies
or installation. Note any remaining limitations and update the relevant docs.
